{"id":"furman-zjp","title":"Add S3 Object Lock support (retention and legal hold)","description":"Implement S3 Object Lock management -- a strong differentiator since only S3 Browser has full support among desktop clients. Object Lock is critical for compliance-focused users (WORM storage, SEC Rule 17a-4, HIPAA).

## Bucket-level
- Enable Object Lock at bucket creation time (cannot be added after)
- Configure default retention mode (Governance / Compliance) and period
- Display Object Lock status in bucket properties

## Object-level
- View retention mode, retain-until date, and legal hold status in object properties
- Set/update retention on individual objects
- Place/remove legal hold on objects
- Batch update retention settings for multiple selected objects

## Backend
- New Tauri commands: s3_get_object_lock_configuration, s3_put_object_lock_configuration, s3_get_object_retention, s3_put_object_retention, s3_get_object_legal_hold, s3_put_object_legal_hold
- New service functions in s3/service.rs

## Notes
- Object Lock requires versioning to be enabled
- Compliance mode retention cannot be shortened or removed by any user, including root
- Governance mode can be bypassed with s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"fenio@debian.org","created_at":"2026-02-26T12:58:41Z","created_by":"Bartosz Fenski","updated_at":"2026-02-26T12:58:41Z"}

{"id":"furman-5ws","title":"Add checksum verification on upload/download","description":"Implement data integrity verification using checksums during transfers. Cyberduck offers configurable SHA-256 verification.

## Scope
- Calculate SHA-256 (or CRC32/CRC32C) checksum during upload and include in request
- Verify checksum on download against the stored value
- Support S3 additional checksums feature (x-amz-checksum-sha256, x-amz-checksum-crc32)
- Option to enable/disable verification in preferences (adds CPU overhead)
- Show verification status in transfer completion

## Notes
- S3 already returns ETag (MD5 for non-multipart) which can be used for basic verification
- Additional checksums (SHA-256, CRC32, CRC32C) were added to S3 in 2022
- For multipart uploads, each part has its own checksum
- Consider making this opt-in since it adds CPU overhead on large files","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"fenio@debian.org","created_at":"2026-02-26T13:04:08Z","created_by":"Bartosz Fenski","updated_at":"2026-02-26T13:04:08Z"}
